items.title: How Investors May Respond To Carvana (CVNA) Refinancing To Cut Interest Costs And Extend Debt Maturities
items.summary: Carvana recently upsized and priced a US$1.66 billion Senior Secured Term Loan B, maturing in seven years and priced at one-month Term SOFR plus 2.25%, to redeem in full its 9.00% Senior Secured Notes due 2030 and cut annual cash interest expense by about US$45 million over the next four years. This refinancing, coming as Carvana reports net debt at just 1.0x trailing twelve‑month Adjusted EBITDA, underscores how capital structure moves are reinforcing its balance sheet flexibility.
